kind: bounded static projection from the archived native disassembly; not a decompilation or runtime observation
claim: The uplink payload encoder is selected from the session audio attribute stored on the transmitter at +0x400 and compared against 100.

instructions.note: codec read from the transmitter aattr field
non-100 branches to the encoder path

limitations: Static disassembly only; the vendor library is not executed by this projection.
Establishes which field selects the payload encoding, not which transport or codec the official owner session negotiates.
The +0x400 field is populated by the live media-info receiver documented separately in analysis/talkback-wire.md.
